(A) Every irrational number is a real number.
(8) Every real number is an irrational number.
(Q The sum or difference of a rational number and an irrational number is an irrational number.
(0) The product or quotient of a non-zero rational number with an irrational number is an irrational number.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
